verdicts.reason: Both break up the 'HOHOHO AGENCY' wordmark and reorder it, putting HOHOHO below 'Office Secret Santa' so the brand reads backwards. The lower half of both is a loose scatter of cropped fragments: a floating half-circle, a cut-off light-blue C ring and a stray tree cluster, with no grid and a dead gap under the text. A sets HOHOHO almost as big as the tagline, so they compete for attention, and the text block sits tight to the top behind a tiny decorative shape. B makes HOHOHO clearly secondary and gives the top more room, so it is slightly cleaner, but it has the same broken composition.
